verdict.rationale: First-party docs say CodeRabbit appends a generated summary, grouped by change type, to the PR description after each review. Every review also posts a structured walkthrough comment at the top of the thread, reviews start automatically when a PR is opened, and summaries can be refreshed via @coderabbitai commands. Large diffs additionally get range-specific summaries and diagrams. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the summaries and walkthroughs actually help reviewers orient faster.
